title: BetaManagedAgentsMcpProbe
description: The failing step of an MCP validation probe.

method.description: The MCP method that failed (for example `initialize` or `tools/list`).

http_response.description: The HTTP error response from the MCP server, or `null` if the MCP server didn't return one for the failing step, for example after a timeout or a DNS or TLS failure.
